item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 23/Mar/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will persist over the coastal areas of Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be hot during the day over the region, and foggy in the morning and at night. With the southerly airstream being replaced by a weak northeast monsoon midweek next week, temperatures will drop slightly over the coastal areas of southern China. Upper-air disturbances are expected to bring unsettled weather to southern China over next weekend. There will be showers and thunderstorms over the region.
